Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting local governments to opt out of prevailing wage requirements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permitting local governments to opt out ofprevailing wage requirements; amending RCW 39.04.260; and adding a newsection to chapter 39.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A county, municipality, or political subdivision of the statemay, by majority vote of the local governing body, opt out of therequirements of this chapter for public works and public buildingservice maintenance contracts estimated to cost less than five milliondollars, exclusive of engineering fees, land acquisition costs, taxes,and the cost of any change orders. (2) An awarding agency may subdivide or otherwise disaggregate apublic works project to qualify for this section. (3) For purposes of this section, "local governing body" means acouncil, board, commission, or other legislative authority charged withgoverning the county, municipality, or political subdivision of thestate.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 39.04.260 and 1993 c 110 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, any work,construction, alteration, repair, or improvement, other than ordinarymaintenance, that the state or a municipality causes to be performed bya private party through a contract to rent, lease, or purchase at leastfifty percent of the project by one or more state agencies ormunicipalities shall comply with chapter 39.12 RCW. (2) This section does not apply to work, construction, alteration,repair, or improvement, other than ordinary maintenance, that is exemptfrom the requirements of chapter 39.12 RCW under section 1 of this act.
